title: On-Premise Voice-to-Voice AI Call Center Agent
confidentiality: employer-owned telecom infrastructure — publish outcomes/percentages only, no raw dashboard screenshots, node counts, or internal system names until cleared
heroImage: RESERVED — gallery component must render gracefully with an empty array until you add images
overview: Replaced human call-center operations with an autonomous voice-to-voice AI agent, orchestrating intent detection, knowledge retrieval, and live API/CRM actions under on-premise deployment constraints.
problem: Human-staffed call handling could not scale concurrent conversations without adding headcount, and response latency varied with load. The business needed an on-premise path that kept audio and customer data inside operator infrastructure while still connecting to CRM and ticketing for real resolutions — not a cloud demo that failed under peak traffic.
solution: End-to-end LangGraph orchestration with intent detection, RAG-based knowledge retrieval, and API integration as binding tools. ASR, LLM, and TTS run as separately pooled services behind Nginx load balancing so each modality can scale and fail independently, with Prometheus/Grafana for production visibility.

results: Integrated with CRM/ticketing for full automation
lessonsLearned: Separating ASR, LLM, and TTS into load-balanced pools mattered more than any single model upgrade: latency and concurrency improved only after the control plane stopped treating the stack as one monolithic GPU process. Tool-bound orchestration (RAG + CRM) kept the agent useful in production instead of conversational-only.

title: Agentic Network Anomaly Detection & Root Cause Analysis (APN Core Layer)
confidentiality: employer-owned telecom infrastructure — publish outcomes/percentages only, no raw dashboard screenshots or node-level specifics until cleared
heroImage: RESERVED — gallery component must render gracefully with an empty array until you add images
overview: Time-series and agentic AI system detecting anomalies on APN nodes across the national telecom network, with automated reporting for operators.
problem: Core-network anomalies were easy to miss in high-volume telemetry, and when they were found, root-cause analysis still depended on expert time. That stretched mean time to repair and left NOC teams reacting from fragmented counters instead of a correlated incident view — especially around seasonality and holiday traffic patterns.
solution: ETL against live OSS data feeds a seasonality- and holiday-aware detection layer; an agentic RCA step correlates signals and pushes structured alerts to email and live dashboards so operators get a usable incident narrative, not only a raw score.

lessonsLearned: Holiday- and seasonality-aware features were non-negotiable in telecom traffic — generic anomaly thresholds produced noise operators ignored. Closing the loop with dashboard feedback kept the detector aligned with how NOC teams actually triage.

title: CV–Job Matching & Personalized Recommendation System
confidentiality: employer-owned platform — treat as sanitized/outcomes-only unless Robin confirms otherwise
heroImage: RESERVED — gallery component must render gracefully with an empty array until you add images
overview: Matching and recommendation system mapping candidate CVs and job posts into embedding/sparse vector space, plus a personalized ranking layer and recruiter-facing chatbot.
problem: Keyword-heavy matching under-ranked strong candidates and over-ranked superficial overlaps. Recruiter preference was not captured as a first-class signal, and job posts were often incomplete — so even a better index still produced weak shortlists until data quality and personalization were addressed together.
solution: Hybrid embedding + sparse retrieval on Elasticsearch, then migration of search and recommendations to Vespa.ai for GPU-accelerated ranking and a proper recommendation layer. Preference vectors update from user actions; an industry chatbot improves job-post completeness before matching.

lessonsLearned: Elasticsearch could carry hybrid search, but recommendation + preference updates pushed complexity past the point where Vespa’s ranking profiles were the cleaner production bet. Improving job-post completeness via the chatbot moved relevance as much as the retrieval model itself.

title: Responsible AI Pipeline for Automated ESG Compliance Processing
confidentiality: regulated financial-reporting client — treat as sanitized/outcomes-only unless Procycons confirms otherwise
heroImage: RESERVED — gallery component must render gracefully with an empty array until you add images
overview: Auditable document-processing microservices for regulated ESG/financial reporting — durable workflows, structured extraction, and validation suitable for compliance review.
problem: ESG and lifecycle reports arrived in inconsistent formats; manual extraction was slow, hard to audit, and brittle under review. The system had to survive long-running parses and retries without losing lineage — “best effort” LLM output was not acceptable for regulated reporting.
solution: Temporal.io + FastAPI event-driven microservices orchestrate ingestion, NLP extraction, and table detection. Prompt optimization and output validation gate results into an auditable store so every accepted field has a processing trail.

results: ~80%+ extraction accuracy on complex ESG reports
lessonsLearned: Durability (Temporal) mattered as much as model quality: long documents and flaky extractors needed heartbeats and retries, not a single request/response. Validation as a hard gate kept accuracy claims honest under compliance scrutiny.

title: EviPackAI — RAG Platform for Clinical Evidence-Package Generation
confidentiality: employer-owned clinical platform — treat as sanitized/outcomes-only unless EPG confirms otherwise
heroImage: RESERVED — gallery component must render gracefully with an empty array until you add images
overview: Led a 3-person team building EviPackAI, a production RAG platform for clinical and traditional evidence-package document generation required for TGA market pathways in Australia.
problem: Building evidence packages by hand meant weeks of literature search and citation assembly for each ingredient/indication path. Slow turnaround delayed regulatory readiness, and ungrounded generation was unacceptable where claims must map to licensed medical sources.
solution: End-to-end RAG on a curated golden-source corpus of licensed and open medical literature, with retrieval evaluation, guardrails, and output validation. Delivery followed working increments with a small team so stakeholders saw usable packages early rather than a late big-bang doc dump.

lessonsLearned: Retrieval evaluation and golden-source curation were the product — generation quality followed. Shipping a trunk MVP with a three-person team, then growing package features milestone-by-milestone, kept TGA-facing stakeholders engaged with real drafts instead of slideware.
